# PDFKit 0.17.2

`pdfkit.cjs` is the unmodified `js/pdfkit.standalone.js` build from the official PDFKit 0.17.2 npm package, renamed for CommonJS loading in this ESM project. MIT license retained in `LICENSE`.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfkit/-/pdfkit-0.17.2.tgz
Package SHA-512: `UnwF5fXy08f0dnp4jchFYAROKMNTaPqb/xgR8GtCzIcqoTnbOqtp3bwKvO4688oHI6vzEEs8Q6vqqEnC5IUELw==`

The official standalone build bundles its dependencies and standard fonts, so the server can generate PDF email attachments without a browser installation, native build tools or additional npm setup. It is loaded server-side only and never served as a frontend asset. Update from the official package, verify package integrity, retain licenses and rerun PDF/email tests when upgrading.
